title: Sheinbaum Says Murder of Cuernavaca Morena Councilman Gabriel Rivas Was Ordered
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by[Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Alma E.
Muñoz](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Arturo%20S%C3%A1nchez%20Jim%C3%A9nez%20y%20Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz)
originally appeared in the [November 6, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/06/politica/el-asesinato-
del-morenista-gabriel-rivas-fue-dirigido-la-investigacion-debe-alcazar-a-
quien-lo-ordeno-sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. The [murder of Gabriel Rivas
Ríos](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/04/estados/asesinan-a-
gabriel-rivas-rios-regidor-de-morena-en-cuernavaca), Morena councilman in
Cuernavaca and environmental defender, was **" a homicide ordered and directed
against him,"** President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo affirmed this Friday, who,
in condemning the crime, maintained that the investigation must reach not only
the material killers, but also **" whoever ordered this homicide."**

At her morning press conference at the National Palace, the head of the
Executive said she knew Rivas Ríos and recalled that he had recently denounced
**a real estate development in an area of Cuernavaca** that "could have
environmental problems and was not suitable to be there." She called the crime
"sad, outrageous."

> She detailed that, as soon as the homicide became known, she asked the
> Security Cabinet to support the Morelos prosecutor's office in the
> investigations. "It was a direct homicide, some people on a motorcycle shot
> him directly," she recounted. She added that she will work with Governor
> Margarita González Saravia to review what can be done about the project the
> councilman was fighting against.

Questioned about the effectiveness of the protection mechanisms for
journalists and defenders of human rights and the environment, she asserted
that many environmental activists have federal protection, which prevents them
from reaching "a situation like this one." However, she specified that Rivas
Ríos had not requested any protection. "That does not mean we do not condemn
the homicide," she noted.

Questioned about whether there is impunity regarding the attacks on and
murders of environmental defenders, she acknowledged that "there are cases
that have not been solved," although she maintained that in many others there
are results. She announced that she will ask the Secretary of Governance, Rosa
Icela Rodríguez, to **meet with groups defending nature** "to be able to see
what more we can do."

Rivas Ríos, a founder of Morena, was shot to death on Wednesday afternoon in
Acapantzingo, a neighborhood in the southeast of the Morelos capital.
